# CLI reference

```text
npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant [input.puml] [-o output] [options]
```

`npx -y` downloads and runs the package without installing it. After `npm install -g @grethel-labs/excaliplant` the same command is just `excaliplant`. Node.js 20 or newer is required.

## Options

```text
excaliplant — render PlantUML as hand-drawn Excalidraw, SVG or PNG

Usage:
  excaliplant [input.puml] [-o output] [options]
  cat diagram.puml | excaliplant -f svg > diagram.svg
  excaliplant markdown <file.md> [-i | -o out.md] [--mode inline|file]   (see: excaliplant markdown --help)
  excaliplant skills install --tool <claude|codex|gemini|opencode|cursor|copilot|all>   (see: excaliplant skills list)
  excaliplant mcp [--http <port>]   (MCP server on stdio; same as excaliplant-mcp)

Options:
  -o, --output <file>       Output file (format from extension unless -f is given).
                            With --all, "{n}" in the name is replaced by the block number.
  -f, --format <fmt>        excalidraw | svg | png (default: from extension, else excalidraw)
  -t, --theme <name>        sketch | plain | hachure | mono | dark | blueprint | grethel-labs-dark | pastel-dark | pastel-light | transparent-dark | transparent-light (default: sketch)
      --clean               Clean strokes instead of the hand-drawn look
      --width <px>          PNG width in pixels (16–16000)
      --scale <n>           PNG scale relative to the SVG size (default 2)
      --background <color>  Background colour for SVG/PNG
      --seed <value>        Seed for stroke wobble and element ids
      --page <n>            Page of a newpage document (0-based)
      --all                 Render every @start…@end block
      --include-dir <dir>   Allow !include of files below <dir>
  -D, --define NAME=value   Predefine a preprocessor variable (repeatable)
      --strict              Fail on unrecognised lines
      --max-input-bytes <n> Input size limit (default 2 MiB, max 200 MiB)
      --list-types          List supported diagram types
  -q, --quiet               Do not print warnings
  -h, --help                Show this help
  -v, --version             Show the version
```

## Input

Pass a file, or leave it out (or pass `-`) to read standard input:

```sh
npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant -f svg < diagram.puml > diagram.svg
```

The first `@start…@end` block is rendered. `--all` renders every block and `--page n` picks a page of a document with `newpage`:

```sh
npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant blocks.puml --all -o out-{n}.svg
```

## Output

The format comes from the extension of `-o` (`.svg`, `.png`, anything else is Excalidraw JSON) or from `-f excalidraw|svg|png`. Without `-o` the result is written to stdout; PNG refuses to write to a terminal.

```sh
npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant diagram.puml -o diagram.excalidraw
npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant diagram.puml -o diagram.svg -t dark
npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant diagram.puml -o diagram.png --width 1600 --background "#ffffff"
npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant diagram.puml -o clean.svg --clean
```

SVG output embeds the Excalifont font, so it renders the same everywhere. PNG is rasterised from that SVG: `--width` sets the pixel width, `--scale` a factor relative to the SVG size.

## Preprocessor

Predefine variables with `-D`, and allow `!include` below one directory with `--include-dir`. Without it `!include` of files is refused:

```sh
npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant main.puml --include-dir . -D ENV=prod -o main.svg
```

## Strictness and diagnostics

Unrecognised lines are reported on stderr as `warning (line N): …` and the diagram is still rendered. With `--strict` they fail the run instead; `-q` silences warnings.

```sh
npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant diagram.puml -o diagram.svg --strict
```

Failures print `excaliplant: <message>` and exit with code 1.

## Diagram kinds

`--list-types` prints the supported kinds, their start keywords and titles:

```text
ditaa            @startditaa, @startuml  Ditaa ASCII art
salt             @startsalt, @startuml  Salt wireframe
nwdiag           @startnwdiag, @startuml  Network diagram
sequence         @startuml, @startsequence  Sequence diagram
timing           @startuml, @starttiming  Timing diagram
gantt            @startgantt, @startuml  Gantt chart
activity         @startuml, @startactivity  Activity diagram
legacy-activity  @startuml  Activity diagram (legacy syntax)
archimate        @startuml  ArchiMate diagram
state            @startuml  State diagram
class            @startuml  Class / IE diagram
object           @startuml  Object diagram
usecase          @startuml  Use case diagram
component        @startuml  Component diagram
deployment       @startuml  Deployment diagram
chen             @startchen  Chen ER diagram
dot              @startdot  Graphviz DOT
chronology       @startchronology  Chronology
mindmap          @startmindmap  MindMap
wbs              @startwbs  Work breakdown structure
files            @startfiles  File tree
json             @startjson  JSON data
yaml             @startyaml  YAML data
ebnf             @startebnf  EBNF railroad
regex            @startregex  Regex railroad
math             @startmath  AsciiMath formula
latex            @startlatex  LaTeX formula
chart            @startchart  Chart
creole           @startcreole  Creole text
```
